## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A two-fascicle Vinaya selections-anthology compiled by **Guǎng Chéng** 廣承 ([廣承](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BB%A3%E6%89%BF)) of the late Míng, supplemented and finalised by **Ǒuyì Zhìxù** 蕅益智旭 ([智旭](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E6%97%AD)). 珍敬 *zhēnjìng* "treasured and revered" indicates the genre — a devotional-pedagogical anthology of Vinaya material.

**Abstract**

The text is a working anthology of select Vinaya passages organised for late-Míng monastic instruction. Zhìxù's *huìbǔ* "compilation and supplementation" reflects his foundational role in the late-Míng Vinaya revival. The anthology format made the work suitable for daily monastic study and for non-specialist monastic education.
